Imran Gill
Frontend Engineer | Whitefield, Bangalore
imran.gill600@example.com | +91 9472652104

Experienced frontend engineer with a strong focus on Vue.js and user-centric interfaces. I blend UI/UX design sensibilities with engineering rigor to deliver performant, accessible web applications. Comfortable working in Agile teams and iterating quickly from prototype to production.

Experience

Dream11 — May 2022 - Present
Vue.js Developer
- Implemented Nuxt.js-based SSR pages and optimized client-side hydration, reducing Time to Interactive by 28% for key match pages using Vue.js and HTML.
- Built a reusable component library in Vue.js covering scoreboard, odds widgets and modal systems, increasing development velocity and reducing duplicate code by 42%.
- Collaborated with designers to refine layouts and accessibility; integrated Figma-driven specs into production components and cut visual regressions by 35% through automated checks.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, tracked work in Jira, and used Linux-based CI runners to deploy staged releases with zero-downtime rollouts.

Razorpay — Sep 2021 - Apr 2022
Frontend Developer
- Led development of payment UI flows using Vue.js and modern JavaScript, improving conversion rates by 12% on checkout forms through iterative A/B tests and HTML refinements.
- Built client-side validation and error-handling modules to reduce payment failures due to UI issues by 20%.
- Worked closely with backend and QA to ship secure integrations; documented components and tickets in Jira to streamline cross-team handoffs.
- Optimized bundle size and load performance using code-splitting and lazy-loading patterns on Linux-based build servers.

Quanta Retail — Aug 2018 - Aug 2021
UI/UX Designer
- Designed end-to-end retail web interfaces in Figma, creating high-fidelity prototypes and design systems that standardized product pages and navigation.
- Conducted usability tests and iterated on UI/UX Design to improve task completion rates by 30% for product search and checkout flows.
- Translated Figma designs into HTML prototypes and collaborated with frontend engineers to ensure pixel-accurate implementations.
- Managed design backlog and sprint priorities in Jira, participating in Agile planning and reviews.

Projects
- Responsive Component Kit: Developed a small Vue.js component kit with accessible form controls and grid utilities, documented from Figma specs and used as a starter in internal projects.
- Checkout UX Study: Led a UI/UX Design study to rework checkout flows, producing annotated Figma files and HTML prototypes that informed a 3-week implementation sprint.

Languages: JavaScript, HTML
